programme.title: Ishqiya
programme.desc: Khalujaan and Babban, two thugs, are on the run from their boss. They seek refuge at an old friend's house but meet Krishna, his widow, instead. Both of them fall for her, oblivious to the fact that Krishna is manipulating them for her own gain.

programme.title: Naqaab
programme.desc: Sophia, a middle-class girl, gets engaged to a millionaire Karan who dearly loves her. But soon she meets the man of her dreams in Vicky, a struggling but ambitious actor. This love triangle causes twists and turns which leave their lives rattled.

programme.title: Mujhse Shaadi Karogi
programme.desc: Sameer, a hot-tempered guy relocates to Goa, where he falls in love with Rani. However, his new roommate Sunny puts a spoke in the wheel upon his arrival and Rani finds herself in a dilemma as she starts liking both Sameer and Sunny.

programme.title: Mickey Virus
programme.desc: Two police officers approach a street smart hacker, Mickey Arora, to help them solve a case. Mickey, along with his friends sets out to crack the case and unravels a complex web of deceit, conspiracy, and danger.

programme.title: Hello Hum Lallan Bol Rahe Hain
programme.desc: Lallan, a security guard, loves Saroja, who is supposed to get married to an older man for money. However, while convincing her to change her mind, he finds out another shocking fact about her.

programme.title: Luck
programme.desc: Musa, an underworld kingpin and a firm believer in luck, designs a series of life threatening adventure sports with hefty prize money for people around the world. However, the participants can only survive and win if they are exceptionally lucky.
